items.title: Microchip Technology (MCHP) Unveiled A Radiation Tolerant Atomic Clock For Satellites
items.summary: Microchip Technology (NasdaqGS:MCHP) announced the Space CSAC-SA65, a radiation tolerant Chip Scale Atomic Clock designed for satellite systems. The Space CSAC-SA65 targets compact, low power timing needs for electronics operating in challenging environments such as Low Earth Orbit. The product is aimed at improving timing accuracy for growing satellite and space technology applications while helping reduce system complexity and costs.
